title: Taherun & Hannan website redesign

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace now contains a standalone wedding-book website, with the prior Next.js source removed:
bullets: One standalone HTML file contains all page markup, CSS, page-turn behavior, and lightbox behavior.
The site includes an invitation details page, photo gallery, family invitation page, page-turn controls, and two local wedding photos.
The established visual system uses cream, ivory, gold, charcoal, Cormorant Garamond, Inter, and Great Vibes.
Prior requests established standalone single-file delivery and detailed responsive checks across mobile, tablet, desktop, portrait, and landscape.

proposed_outcome: Redesign the complete Taherun & Hannan wedding invitation site in its existing standalone HTML file, using the supplied visual references and confirmed styling direction while retaining the essential wedding information and invitation interactions. Validate layout, scrolling, accessibility, and interactions across the agreed viewport/device matrix.

answer.value:
Here is a tailored response you can use for this section, keeping in mind common elements of a wedding website that usually need to remain untouched during a redesign:

Recommended Answer
Yes, the following elements and sections must remain unchanged during the redesign:

Core Registry Links & Cash Funds: The external URLs, text, and integrations for active gift registries and honeymoon funds must remain intact to prevent broken contribution links.

Primary Event Details (Date & Core Venue): While the visual layout can change, the official wedding date and primary venue address/location text must stay accurate.

Historical/Archive Content: Any photo galleries or personal couple backstory text marked as locked/permanent should be preserved in the new layout.
